from collections import Counter as C
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[row[:] for row in g]
    cnt=C(v for row in g for v in row)
    rects={}; seeds=[]
    for col in cnt:
        if col==0: continue
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==col]
        r0=min(x[0] for x in cells); r1=max(x[0] for x in cells); c0=min(x[1] for x in cells); c1=max(x[1] for x in cells)
        perim=[(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if r in(r0,r1) or c in(c0,c1)]
        if all(g[r][c]==col for r,c in perim) and len(cells)==len(perim):
            rects[col]=(r0,r1,c0,c1)
        else: seeds+=cells
    sc=C(g[r][c] for r,c in seeds)
    for col,(r0,r1,c0,c1) in rects.items():
        need=sum(1 for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1) if (r-r0+c-c0)%2==0)
        fill=[s for s,n in sc.items() if n==need]
        if len(fill)==1:
            fc=fill[0]
            for r in range(r0+1,r1):
                for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                    if (r-r0+c-c0)%2==0: out[r][c]=fc
    return out
